item.title: Version 1.5.5
item.changes: Filter › RGB Split: rainbow dispersion, linear or radial, with blur streaks. Progressive Blur, Bloom / Glow and RGB Split as adjustment layers. Export As › Channel Pack packs layers into a PNG's red, green, blue and alpha, for game textures. Photoshop artboards each open in a tab of their own. Copy and paste work in file names when saving, and shortcuts work on non-Latin keyboards. Image Size keeps the zoom, and small images open at 100%.
